encounter: Giant hyenas attack Karawa
qualification: The two hyenas and anonymous villagers are distinguished by their narrated targets and positions, not invented names. Unidentified “dead” map tokens do not establish extra casualties.
ending: Both giant hyenas are dead; the four adventurers remain on the battlefield as villagers scatter. The wounded young man has been stabilized. Beli’s divine attacks failed throughout; later healing at the teahouse occurs after this combat.

encounter: Three giant lizards at Gomat Oasis
ending: All three lizards are dead; the party congratulates one another and begins investigating the deserted camp.

encounter: Four skeletons emerging from the mound outside the ruined fort
enemy_roster_note: Sword-bearing and unarmed labels can refer to the same skeleton at different points in the fight.
qualification: Seeker is omitted from the initial initiative handling, acts after Kenzo in the first cycle, and resumes his corrected place immediately after Wellby in the next cycle.
ending: All four skeletons are destroyed outside the fort. The party remains beside the partially excavated mound and hopes no more will emerge.

encounter: Burrowing ankheg ambush in the fort
qualification: Includes the ambush and readied Eldritch Blast immediately before initiative.
ending: The ankheg is dead; Wellby has been freed and healed.

encounter: Skeletons and the staff-bearing undead hobgoblin
enemy_roster_note: The staff's influence persists after the creatures are destroyed.
qualification: Includes the immediate ambush/setup before initiative; ends when the enemies are defeated. The later work to destroy the staff has no repeated ordered turn cycle.
ending: All three skeletons and the undead hobgoblin are destroyed. The fallen staff’s obsidian continues radiating rage; its later destruction happens after the fight.

encounter: Gnolls and maw creatures at the northern camp
enemy_roster_note: One gnoll remains asleep at the end of initiative.
qualification: Three gnolls and three maw creatures are tracked using descriptive labels. Maw identity is only as precise as the spoken targets and corrections permit; map gestures alone do not establish persistent individual identities.
ending: The two awake gnolls and all three maw creatures are dead. One gnoll remains asleep with roughly thirty seconds before waking; the DM ends initiative and asks what the party does next.

encounter: Gnoll ambush at the roadside rock camp
enemy_roster_note: Weapon and positional labels shift. No exact total inferred from actor-label count.
qualification: Enemy labels distinguish repeated initiative positions and weapon roles; map-only pointers do not establish all individual targets. Unspoken damage and resolutions remain unstated.
ending: Riswynn kills the fleeing final gnoll; the ambush is over and the party survives.

encounter: Stony tentacled creature in the dwarven marketplace
enemy_roster_note: Descriptive identity retained. No stat block inferred.
ending: The party kills the creature by staying outside its reach and wearing it down with ranged attacks and the heated arrow; it cracks and falls to the floor.

encounter: Undead hobgoblins in the old prison
ending: Both undead hobgoblins are dead. The fight is described as quiet; Kenzo ends the encounter before another Riswynn turn is resolved.

encounter: Orc and shapeshifting guards in the second tower
enemy_roster_note: One guard remains asleep. The transforming and sleeping guards are distinct.
qualification: Includes the opening Sleep spell whose audible result immediately triggers initiative; the guard remains asleep when the ordered fight ends.
ending: The orc and the transforming guard are dead; the guard by the stairs remains asleep. Binding, interrogation discussion, and Vola’s retrieval happen after the ordered fight.

encounter: Scouts intercept an undead gnoll outside the keep
enemy_roster_note: Killed before taking a regular turn.
ending: The undead gnoll is killed before it can enter the keep.

encounter: Demon and undead gnolls in Raven’s Hold keep
enemy_roster_note: Vola fights alongside the party.
qualification: The table grants Wellby, Seeker, and Delwath opening surprise actions before the regular cycle. Vola has no resolved turn in the third recorded cycle; none is invented.
ending: The demon vanishes and all three undead gnolls are dead. The party regroups; Kenzo remains poisoned with visibly diseased flesh.

encounter: Gnoll attack on the gatehouse
enemy_list: Gnoll leader | gnoll hunters and other gnolls | small flying demon | 3 hyenas
enemy_roster_note: Hyenas are put to sleep. The small demon dies before taking a regular turn.
ending: Kenzo finishes the remaining gate attackers and emerges alive. The leader and small demon have fallen; one gnoll has escaped and the three hyenas remain asleep.

encounter: Pursuit into the outer plaza
ending: All four gnolls in the plaza fight are dead; only the captive animals are heard.

encounter: Vine-and-mud creature at the river crossing
qualification: The DM runs the fight without an initiative roll or encounter tracker. Vola’s participation is confirmed afterwards, but her individual actions are not recorded. No initiative roll; the table repeats an ordered cycle of party actions and enemy turns. Includes the initial attack and immediate dispersal of the mists.
ending: The creature dies and is swept downstream. The obstruction breaks, water floods freely through the valley, and the mists clear.

encounter: Living lightning in the tower library
ending: Delwath escapes alive and lands outside in a heap. The lightning creature is not defeated.

encounter: Steam and dust creatures at the tower pool
enemy_list: 3 steam creatures | 3 dust creatures | water-snake guardian
enemy_roster_note: The guardian directs the creatures and survives under the pool.
qualification: The table alternates enemy actions and one turn per participating PC, allowing flexible order within the party turn. Kenzo continues meditating upstairs and does not join the fight. No initiative roll is recorded; repeated party turns alternate with enemy turns through the defeat of the steam and dust creatures.
ending: All three steam and three dust creatures are defeated. The water guardian remains alive and agitated under the pool’s surface; the dislodged sphere remains nearby.

encounter: Six gnolls on the plains south of the tower
qualification: The party rolls initiative with disadvantage from exhaustion. The brief rest bookkeeping inside the first round credits the earlier breakfast rest.
ending: The leader and all five skeletal gnolls are dead; Kenzo’s two unarmed strikes finish the last opponent.

encounter: Giant vultures at Bas Udda
qualification: The two diving vultures receive attacks before the regular initiative cycle; the other five act after Kenzo. Initiative begins here; the immediately preceding missed Eldritch Blast and diving vultures precipitate the encounter.
ending: Five of the seven vultures are killed and two escape. Havdar goes to organize a watch before joining the party in the temple.

encounter: Three ogres in the canyon
enemy_roster_note: One is described wielding a chain.
qualification: The pursuit uses repeated movement turns before the initiative roll. Two additional ogres join the regular cycle in round 3, acting before Delwath. The resolved repeated movement cycle of the pursuit precedes the initiative roll; the chase and ensuing fight form one continuous ordered encounter.
ending: All three ogres are dead, each finished by Wellby’s arrows; Seeker’s inspiration rune helps deliver the final killing shot.

encounter: Orc attack on Havdar’s camp
enemy_list: Orc raiders, including their leader, armored spellcaster and fire caster
enemy_roster_note: Role labels are retained without assuming that each label identifies a distinct additional orc.
qualification: Four main initiative cycles are followed by openly offered cleanup attacks, retained as events after the last regular turn.
ending: The fight is resolved. The armored caster is unconscious and captive in the stone hand; the other attackers are defeated. Several of Havdar’s troops below are wounded, unconscious, or possibly dead, with their condition unresolved at this distance.

encounter: Manticores in the dining hall
qualification: Initiative tie discussion begins the fight; young manticores are dispatched in two additional rounds summarized by the DM.
ending: Both adult manticores and both young are dead; the final two rounds against the young are compressed in the source.

encounter: Orc patrol outside the dining hall
enemy_list: Orc captain | orc spellcaster | orc soldiers
enemy_roster_note: The captain surrenders. Soldier labels can overlap.
qualification: The initial cycle is the surprise opportunity specifically awarded to unseen Wellby and Kenzo; the other PCs do not receive turns in that partial cycle.
ending: The captain drops his weapons and surrenders under Suggestion; the remaining patrol is defeated.

encounter: Shadow ambush at the second desert camp
qualification: Four cycles follow the recurring actor order; the final remaining dog is finished without resolving further turns. The opening attack and howl precede regular initiative turns.
ending: Resolved: both humanoid shadows and all three shadow dogs are destroyed; two horses are dead, three survive, and Delwath has lost Strength. The final dog is dispatched by compressed narration.

encounter: Shadows attack the Shakun initiation
enemy_roster_note: Includes a shadow spawned from a slain mystai during combat.
qualification: The party begins unarmored and without weapons but can use spell foci; ritual water breathing and harmless blue flames remain active. The opening and early enemy turns precede the first fully narrated PC cycle; grouping preserves resolved sequence without deriving elapsed time. Includes the initiating attack that kills an acolyte immediately before the initiative call.
ending: The last shadow is destroyed and the encounter ends. Seven shadows fought here (six pursuers plus one spawned from the first slain mystai); two mystai died and one survived. Delwath and Seeker suffered Strength drain.

encounter: Agata and Samerki at Shakun’s Wellspring
enemy_roster_note: Cintra and the fire elemental support the PCs.
ending: Samerki is killed by Kenzo; Wellby kills Agata after regaining his form. Her body disintegrates and the session ends before any aftermath or reunion with Jumi.

encounter: Gnolls at the wellspring entrance
enemy_list: Gnoll archers | gnoll fighters | rotting clawed creature
enemy_roster_note: The source also has an unidentified spell attacker. Its identity and side are unresolved, so it is not added as another enemy.
qualification: Initial attacks are interleaved informally before side initiative is agreed. Later turns are grouped into the four observable cycles; no world-time duration is inferred. No resolved elemental turn in cycle three or boulder turn in cycle four is supplied. The DM initially dispenses with standard initiative, then explicitly uses side initiative with repeated party/enemy cycles; setup through capture is one continuous fight.
ending: The attack is defeated; Kenzo captures the last archer alive and the party returns to the wellspring. Its later disposal belongs to the aftermath, not an invented killing blow in this combat.

encounter: Hostile obsidian fly
enemy_roster_note: The fly reverts to its figurine before taking a resolved attack.
ending: The fly returns to stone, ending the encounter without killing it. No fly attack or Delwath turn resolves before reversion.

encounter: Night raid on the canyon camp
enemy_list: Orc raiders, including shadow-using thieves | jackalweres | wereraven
enemy_roster_note: The separate shadow creature hunting down the wereraven supports the party.
qualification: The third cycle includes compressed pursuit and cleanup rather than invented additional numbered rounds.
ending: Camp defense resolves with most raiders killed and the wereraven’s loot returned. One jackalwere escapes; Kenzo and Wellby ride after the mounted orc thief, whose escape remains unresolved at this boundary.

encounter: Memory-eating fungus and corridor slime molds
enemy_roster_note: The fungus survives. The continuous encounter includes the retreat into the slime ambush.
qualification: Wellby receives a free opening turn at the bottom of the order. The retreat continues directly into the slime ambush without rerolling initiative; recorded cycles follow the stated turns, including the new enemies joining after the retreat. One continuous initiative span: memory-eating fungus, retreat, and two slime molds joining the existing order.
ending: Both corridor slime molds are dead. The party escaped the red fungus, which was not killed.

encounter: Giant worm at the planar weak point
enemy_roster_note: The giant fly is a party resource and is recalled safely.
ending: The worm remains alive as a tiny earthworm, the fly is safely recalled, and the party places the vials to begin collecting planar energy.

encounter: Escaped wolf in the archives basement
enemy_roster_note: Dag is subdued alive. Delwath's shadow beast supports the party.
qualification: The repeated order is Kenzo, Wellby, shadow beast/Delwath, wolf, Seeker. The final subdual is accepted in compressed narration; no unspoken later turns are supplied. Dag’s identity is established after the encounter. No initiative roll is retained; the repeated ordered turn cycle begins with Kenzo and continues through the wolf’s knockout.
ending: The wolf is subdued alive and lies unconscious in the basement hallway. The cure occurs later, outside ordered combat.

encounter: Four grotesque animal-statue guardians
enemy_roster_note: Includes crab-lion, goat-headed and snake-headed descriptions. The fourth form is not supplied here.
qualification: Initiative remains the organizing frame across parley, the closed door, and the renewed attempt to pass; the final restrained guardian is destroyed before healing begins.
ending: All four guardians are destroyed; the final restrained guardian crumbles in Seeker’s Earthen Grasp and silence falls.

encounter: Breda, the male guard, and Edmur in the subbasement
enemy_roster_note: All three revert to human bodies after death.
qualification: Includes the readied arrow before the initiative roll and subsequent reinforcements.
ending: All three werewolves die and revert to human bodies. The detached flying rope ladder remains under Seeker’s control, with a stated one-hour animation duration.

encounter: Ladder ambush of two returning werewolf guards
enemy_roster_note: Both die before taking regular turns or transforming.
qualification: Includes the ladder trap and the surprise cycle; initiative is explicitly ended in the following mixed transition turn.
ending: Both guards die in human form without taking regular turns or transforming. The party begins climbing out with Govir.

encounter: Werewolf leader and four reinforcements in the dining room
ending: The leader and his four reinforcements are dead; the ladder survives. The leader’s watery escape was stopped by the thunder rune, and the remaining wolves fought on after his death. Secret bite-save outcomes remain unrevealed.

encounter: Werewolves through the shoemaker shop window
enemy_roster_note: Vistra and Riswynn arrive on the party's side. The ending explicitly records three newly arriving werewolves killed.
qualification: Kenzo has no resolved second-cycle turn in the source. New arrivals are retained in their stated relative order; no missing turn is invented.
ending: All three newly arriving werewolves are dead; Wellby’s final arrow kills the trap master. The damaged storefront opens onto a busy northern Tokra neighborhood. The table does not establish that every werewolf in the city has been eliminated.

encounter: Werewolves and manifestations at the ruined tower
enemy_list: Werewolf man | mouth-covered creature emerging from the sacrifice | hostile shadow creature
enemy_roster_note: The restrained woman and muttering captive are kept separate from the attacking manifestations. PC compulsions occur within this encounter.
qualification: The shadow explicitly acts twice per cycle until it shrinks and loses one turn. The apparent initial surrender does not end the continuous ordered encounter. One continuous initiative cycle includes the apparent surrender, manifestations, and rescue from the mist; quiet returns only afterward.
ending: The mouth-covered creature is destroyed and the shadow dissipates. Riswynn is rescued from the continuing mist compulsion. The mad captive is dead; the werewolf man is unconscious behind the tower and the woman remains cowering in the tower.

encounter: Bandit horn signal and intimidation
enemy_roster_note: Initiative resolves signaling and intimidation. The companions flee before any resolved attack.
qualification: Initiative orders a horn signal and intimidation. The scouts flee or surrender after about two minutes. Initiative is rolled for the horn signal and intimidation; the encounter resolves when the scouts flee or surrender, before the ensuing questioning.
ending: The horn bearer is too frightened to speak and his companions flee. No attack or injury is resolved before questioning begins.

encounter: Two wyverns ambush the party on the road
enemy_roster_note: The hired bandits fight alongside the party.
qualification: The first recorded cycle contains the surprise attack; the DM explicitly confirms that only the wyverns and Wellby acted in it. Later cycles follow the repeated initiative order. Continuous initiative includes the surprised opening cycle, tactical discussion, and corrections. The surviving wyvern remains polymorphed when active initiative gives way to capture planning.
ending: One wyvern is killed and the other remains a harmless but temporary turtle. One bandit archer and his horse are dead; Kenzo survives badly hurt. The turtle’s mirror capture happens after initiative.

encounter: Roadside clash with Kadmos and his companions
enemy_roster_note: Marcella intervenes to stop the clash. Antonia's subsequent healing is outside the combat.
ending: The fighting stops with Kenzo unconscious but stabilized and Kadmos badly wounded. The DM explicitly drops initiative. Antonia’s subsequent 6-point healing and the resumed negotiation occur after this combat.

encounter: Mirror theft, pursuit, and battle at the ruined temple
enemy_list: Kadmos | Casian | Marcella | Kadmos's summoned spirit
enemy_roster_note: The summoned entity is described in a red gorilla-like form and later called a ghost. The seven hired bandits and Delwath's shadow beast are party allies.
qualification: The theft and pursuit use repeated ordered turns before the formal initiative roll at u2932–u2933; the continuous encounter ends with the negotiated departure.
ending: The continuous encounter ends by negotiation. All seven hired bandits are dead; all five PCs and the three attacking Chardonians survive. Casian pays 175 gold for the dependents, Kadmos keeps the top, and the Chardonians agree to leave for Chardon. Marcella’s weapons are to be returned. Her Haste ring is actually returned during the separate private farewell at u4226, after this segment.

encounter: Poison troll beside the smoldering wyvern nest
qualification: The surprise opening and readied-action dispute are reconciled by the DM’s u0392–u0402 narration. Kenzo’s interposition is an adjudicated event; the transcript does not explicitly call it a mechanical reaction.
ending: The troll is trapped alive in the mirror, and Kenzo deactivates it. No stick throw or further troll turn resolves.

encounter: Fausto’s workshop ambush and escape
enemy_roster_note: Shifting positional labels are not counted as additional guardians. Riswynn is absent from the fight despite her player's table participation.
qualification: Riswynn’s player participates at the table but her character is absent. Armor of Agathys and Kenzo’s precombat readied attack are proposed, not separately resolved. The source narrates Fausto’s return and the rescue sequence without announcing every cycle; no missing attacks or turns are supplied. Continuous initiative and escape, including the table’s compressed reunion that ends the ordered action; Riswynn is absent from the fight.
ending: All four survive and escape the tower, recovering both giant eyes, five stones and the magical mace, then reunite with Riswynn under pursuit. Fausto retains the Pandemonium scroll. Neither Fausto nor the constructs is defeated.

encounter: Shadow dogs at the dead stretch of riverbank
enemy_roster_note: Dogs are killed or confined, with five surviving to continue the pursuit. No distinct-animal total is calculated across both session-50 encounters.
qualification: The last wall-top attacks are narrated in compressed form. Source u4025–u4027 reports three dogs killed, and u4289–u4292 reports four remaining after a further kill; these later counts support the confined dogs’ outcome.
ending: The party rides on under daylight with five surviving dogs still following. The two confined dogs and the mace victim account for the three killed before the next confrontation; this fight does not end the pursuit.

encounter: Ambush of the pursuing shadow dogs
enemy_roster_note: Continues the same pursuit after the earlier riverbank encounter. The ladder is a party ally.
ending: All pursuing shadow dogs are dead. Ladder has recovered from fear but is distant, and two horses remain scattered; their recovery and healing occur after initiative.

encounter: Mezzar at the god tree
enemy_roster_note: Six Deno'qai, including Zevi, are present and killed by Mezzar. Their only extracted turn is lost to surprise, so they are not listed as additional attacking enemies.
qualification: After discussion, the accepted order is Wellby, Kenzo, Seeker, Mezzar, the Deno’qai, and Delwath. Only the Deno’qai are surprised. Mezzar already knows Wellby is concealed above the ground. Initiative begins with Wellby’s attack declaration; the encounter includes the continuing ordered escape until combat is explicitly stopped.
ending: All four PCs escape alive into the forest; Delwath has been revived. The rope ladder and all six Deno’qai are dead. Mezzar flies toward the village and combat is explicitly stopped.

encounter: Grimbaskal’s banyan-tree lair
enemy_roster_note: Theba and Obel support the party. The lair contributes effects.
qualification: The regular cycle is Kenzo, Wellby, the lair, Grimbaskal, Seeker, Theba, Obel, the snake people, and Delwath. Lair effects occur just before the dragon’s initiative-19 turn. Prearranged blessings and poison protection are already in effect; the opening fright saves retain the spear’s advantage. The continuous encounter includes the ten-minute compressed crab-versus-snakes resolution after the dragon falls.
ending: Grimbaskal and all four snake people are dead. All four PCs, Theba, and Obel survive; Theba was last recorded at 3 hit points. The chain ladder was destroyed. Obel finishes the snake people during a narrated ten-minute continuation, then returns from crab form.

encounter: Harpoon shadow in the first ruin
qualification: No initiative roll; the repeated Iascaire, Delwath, creature, Aristaea turn order is confirmed at u0544–u0548.
ending: The shadow is destroyed and a healing flame remains over the body.

encounter: Two harpoon shadows in the collapsed building
ending: Both shadows are destroyed and the party turns to searching for the wizard’s armband.

encounter: Demon corpse and animated forest at Dark Fire
enemy_list: Animated trees and twig blights | 2 fiendish wasp swarms | demonic wolf | demonic boars
enemy_roster_note: New trees animate during the fight. The demon corpse is the source of threats. Yezali, hunting-cat spirits and the wildfire spirit support the party.
qualification: The opening Heat Metal and immediate tree response precede the first announced regular PC turn. Regular cycles follow the repeating Aristaea → Delwath → enemies → Iascaire sequence, retaining separate summon turns, count-20 animation and later initiative-14 arrivals. Includes the escape ending the encounter at u3133; that inseparable turn also contains closing housekeeping.
ending: The wrist circlet is destroyed and Yezali is freed. The party escapes about a mile east with hunting-cat spirits covering the retreat; surviving monsters remain tied to the demon’s vicinity. No long rest or departure from the forest is established.

encounter: Hobgoblin portal company and one-armed wizard
enemy_list: Hobgoblin soldiers | greatsword officer | longsword warlord | one-armed hobgoblin wizard
enemy_roster_note: Officer titles fluctuate in the source. Weapon roles distinguish the two officer actors.
qualification: Officer titles shift between lieutenant, captain, sergeant and warlord. Greatsword officer and longsword warlord distinguish the two resolved combat roles without inventing personal names.
ending: The ground troops and officers are dead; the wizard loses Fly and dies on hitting the shadow plane’s ground.

encounter: Cocoon-bound skeletal warlock at Yemo’te
enemy_list: Skeletal hobgoblin warlock | skeletal minions and archers | bone swarm
enemy_roster_note: Skeletal role labels are grouped without inferring a total head count.
ending: The DM declares Aristaea’s radiant pike strike destroys the warlock; every other undead collapses. The armband is destroyed after initiative and is not an extra combat turn.

encounter: Six shriveled dwarves at the blocked clifftop cave
enemy_list: 6 shriveled dwarven undead: 4 archers and 2 shadow spellcasters
enemy_roster_note: Wight and positional labels overlap with the six established attackers.
ending: All six attackers are dead after Thror’s final Shocking Grasp. Their dwarven spirits rise; the party survives outside the blocked cave. Rothfis’s maximum hit points remain reduced by 6 until a long rest, as confirmed afterward.

encounter: Two unbalanced dinosaurs attacking Elazar
ending: Both dinosaurs escape into the jungle. Elazar survives, wounded but able to prop himself up and speak.

encounter: Spirit troll in the Ashfields
ending: The spirit troll dissipates, and Rothfis revives with 1 hit point. The party remains in the Ashfields.

encounter: Hagrim and the spirits in the underground throne room
enemy_list: Hagrim | hostile spirit advisers | summoned specters | wraith | swarm of limbs
enemy_roster_note: Spirit role labels are retained without claiming that every label is a separate unique creature.
ending: Riswynn chooses redemption rather than punishment. The chalice’s flood dissolves Morkalan around the party and ends the fight; the gods’ eventual judgment of Hagrim is not shown.

encounter: Fire wasps and corrupted ankylosaurus at the lava river
enemy_roster_note: Enari and the magma dancer support or survive alongside the PCs.
qualification: Begins with Enari's fog intervention immediately before initiative; the final whole turn includes the dinosaur's death and Ember's first question.
ending: Both fire wasps and the corrupted ankylosaurus are dead. Kenzo has been freed of the venom’s poison and paralysis; the magma dancer survives and opens a wary conversation as the dinosaur sinks into the lava.

encounter: Wellby attacks the Skullcleaver pirate ship
enemy_list: Skullcleaver pirate crew, including crossbow fighters and a crow's-nest sailor
enemy_roster_note: Solo ship attack. The burning sail is an objective rather than another enemy.
qualification: No initiative roll is announced; repeated crossbow volleys and Wellby’s alternating actions establish an ordered turn cycle.
ending: Wellby escapes crossbow range. The pirate crew controls the fire, but the destroyed sail prevents pursuit of the faster Wave Dancer. No ship is stated to sink.

encounter: Shark riders and the stone turbine
enemy_list: 3 sharks | 3 hostile sailors or shark riders
enemy_roster_note: The sailor and rider labels overlap. Two sailors die and one is held conscious.
pc_regular_turn_actors: Alimash | Artem Novolozek | Rufus | Shoal | Wellby
ending: The three sharks and two sailors are dead. Alimash and Shoal hold the surviving sailor conscious, and Artem is free of the stopped turbine. The later ritual and recovery are outside initiative.

encounter: Kenku rescue, huge shark and hidden mage
enemy_list: Huge shark | hidden mage | 3 hostile sailors | aboleth tentacle
enemy_roster_note: The tentacle is an extension of the aboleth encountered separately afterward. The shark is polymorphed and survives.
pc_regular_turn_actors: Alimash | Artem Novolozek | Rufus | Shoal | Wellby
ending: The mage is down and visible again. All three sailors are unconscious, with the bleeding one stabilized. Both Kenku have been freed but are unconscious and have been pulled back into the hostage chamber. The shark remains a living turtle in the turbine room above; removal to the open ocean is handled afterward.

encounter: Aboleth and charmed sea-elf knights
enemy_roster_note: Alimash becomes enslaved during the fight, but the aboleth dies before he attacks the party. He remains a PC in this roster.
pc_regular_turn_actors: Alimash | Artem Novolozek | Rufus | Shoal | Wellby
ending: Artem’s Lightning Bolt kills the aboleth before enslaved Alimash can attack him. Alimash and the two conscious sea elves are released from its control; another elf was knocked out nonlethally. Rufus is still dying, with treatment stated to be readily possible but not played out. The crystal’s prisoner and treasure remain unresolved at the cutoff.

encounter: Crystal swarms inside the mountain
qualification: Mikasa resolves before Spirala in the first cycle at the DM’s invitation; the later order is expressly confirmed as Spirala, Mikasa, then Raven. The ending compresses the remaining melee rather than supplying unrecorded attacks.
ending: All five crystal swarms are destroyed. The DM resolves the final two collectively once Raven and Mikasa can reach them.

encounter: Living spells and the petrified earth creature
enemy_list: Petrified earth creature and magical core | living Catapult boulder | living lightning bolt | living giant dragonfly | living force hand | 3 living chaos bolts | living burning hand
enemy_roster_note: Living spells are identified by their played forms. No published stat blocks inferred.
qualification: Seeker’s first turn is delayed by connection trouble and resolved after Mikasa; later cycles resume Seeker before Mikasa. The garbled additional benefit at u2383–u2384 is not assigned an invented recipient or effect.
ending: The statue collapses, its exposed magical core is destroyed, and all remaining living spells vanish. The party feels the magic rebalancing.

encounter: Vortex and grasping water
enemy_roster_note: Environmental challenge: vortex and grasping water. No enemy creature established.
qualification: Ordered action cycles resolve passage through the vortex. Retained under the current combat classification. No initiative roll is made; four recorded cycles follow Kenzo, Enari and Izzarak. The final cycle records only Kenzo’s exit. No initiative roll: the vortex confrontation repeats an ordered Kenzo, Enari, Izzarak turn cycle.
ending: Izzarak and Kenzo reach the dry, mist-covered side of the vortex. Enari’s final crossing is not narrated here; his last recorded attempt is still in the current. Later play places him with them at Motua.

encounter: Healing Motua while the severed chains attack
enemy_list: 9 animated or severed chains | hostile shadows
enemy_roster_note: Motua is being healed. Enari fights the shadows. One chain remains bound to Kenzo at the end.
qualification: The first wound was healed immediately before the ordered fight. Kenzo’s subsequent dream scenes and Izzarak’s defenses stay within this single encounter; Enari’s shadow fight is resolved in broad narration. Ordered chain attacks, Izzarak’s defenses and Kenzo’s dream-wound actions form one continuous encounter; the visions do not interrupt combat.
ending: All three wounds are healed and Motua is calm. Eight chains have been destroyed and one remains bound to Kenzo’s soul; he is conscious at 1 hit point with disadvantage on death saves. No final fate is separately narrated for Enari’s two remaining shadows.

encounter: Vondar One-Eye and two twisted satyrs in Long Shadow Ravine
enemy_roster_note: The animated tent is controlled by Seeker.
qualification: One continuous initiative encounter; all tactical and technical interruptions remain inside combat.
ending: All three enemies are killed and covered by the ravine’s dirt. No memory toll is paid. Heat Metal ends; Seeker’s curse has no removal established during the encounter. Subsequent healing and short-rest discussion occur outside initiative.

encounter: Mirror-shard swarms outside Arryn’s tower
qualification: Swarm labels follow their initial targets; later map-pointed attacks are kept collectively where individual targets are not recoverable. No unspoken swarm turn is supplied.
ending: All three swarms are destroyed and their glass ground to powder; the tower door is still locked until Wellby opens it afterward.

encounter: Mirror Alimash and the rescue of Arryn
enemy_roster_note: Real Alimash and Arryn are rescued. The false Arryn is destroyed inside the Mirror Realm.
ending: The false Arryn and mirror Alimash are destroyed. Arryn and Alimash return to the real world; Arryn closes the portal and thanks the party.

encounter: Five cursed harpies at the pillar overhang
qualification: The DM runs ordered turns without an initiative roll, explicitly confirming the repeating cycle at u0994–u1005. Opening charms precede that cycle. No initiative roll; repeated ordered turns are explicitly confirmed at u0994–u1005. The song and countercharms introduce the continuous encounter.
ending: Two harpies are dead, two captured unconscious, and the fifth has landed with Wellby for negotiation. Ordered fighting has ended; the three-question bargain follows outside the combat segment.

encounter: Agata emerges from the Heartwood Tree
enemy_roster_note: Baxter, the animated ladder and the obsidian fly support the party.
